'''Gepko Steringa''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Helmond tournament]] on 10 December 2000 with Grans, according to Maarten Rossou's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1547">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-15-hellmond-the-netherlands-101200d1547/ hellmond-the-netherlands-101200], DeckTech (Maarten "PIET" Rossou, 15 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-15-hellmond-the-netherlands-101200d1547/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
